audience: bookkeepers and finance teams that keep their books in Zero Plus One

useCases.title: Chase invoices that are still open
useCases.text: Read the open invoices report and the aged receivables report. Open the invoices that need action to see their details.

useCases.title: Review profit, cash flow and the balance sheet
useCases.text: Read the profit and loss, cash flow and balance sheet reports. Ask the assistant to explain the main figures in plain words.

useCases.title: Check the VAT 201 figures against the tax rates
useCases.text: Read the VAT 201 return figures for a period. Read the tax rates set up in the organization next to them.

useCases.title: Find bank lines that still need reconciling
useCases.text: Read the reconciliation summary for one ledger account. List the bank lines that still need matching and the suggested matches.

useCases.title: Look up a customer or supplier record
useCases.text: List the customers and suppliers, then open one to read its record.
